raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #40155.

The scheduler's non-overlap speculative path always calls
`self.model_worker.forward_batch_generation(batch, pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors)`
(`srt/managers/scheduler.py`). Two of the seven spec-v2 workers —
`FrozenKVMTPWorkerV2` and `UnoWorkerV2` — never accepted that keyword, so any
model routed through them died on the first speculative step with
`TypeError: ... got an unexpected keyword argument 'pp_proxy_tensors'`.
(DSpark and multi-layer EAGLE were already aligned on `main`; the claimed PR
#44211 was closed unmerged, so nothing here duplicates in-flight work.)

Root cause noted in the issue: `BaseSpecWorker` never declared
`forward_batch_generation`, so each worker evolved its own signature and two
silently fell behind.

## Modifications

- `srt/speculative/frozen_kv_mtp_worker_v2.py`
  - `forward_batch_generation` now takes `pp_proxy_tensors=None`.
  - Passes it through to the target worker prefill call
    (`capture_hidden_mode=CaptureHiddenMode.FULL`) and to `self.verify(...)`
    (inherited from `EAGLEWorkerV2`, which already accepts it) so PP proxy
    tensors reach the target on both the extend and decode paths.
- `srt/speculative/uno_worker_v2.py`
  - `forward_batch_generation` now takes `pp_proxy_tensors=None` and threads
    it through `_forward_prefill` / `_forward_decode` /
    `_forward_decode_tree` / `_run_draft_block` / `_run_target_block` down to
    the two `self.target_worker.forward_batch_generation(...)` call sites
    (prefill, and the `batch=None, is_verify=True` verify path).
- `srt/speculative/base_spec_worker.py`
  - Declares `@abstractmethod forward_batch_generation(batch, on_publish=None,
    grammar_barrier=None, pp_proxy_tensors=None)` on `BaseSpecWorker`, so a
    future worker that forgets the interface fails at instantiation instead of
    at the first request. All six concrete workers (plus
    `StandaloneWorkerV2` via `EAGLEWorkerV2`) already override it, so no
    existing instantiation breaks.

## Tests

No GPU and no `torch` on this machine, so this could not be verified with a
runtime run; the fix is a pure-Python signature/pass-through change. What was
verified here:

- `ruff check --select F401,F821,F823,UP037`, `ruff format --check`,
  `python3 -m py_compile`, and `git diff --check` all pass on the three
  touched files.
- An AST audit of all seven spec-v2 workers confirms every
  `forward_batch_generation` now accepts `pp_proxy_tensors` as a keyword, so
  the scheduler's `forward_batch_generation(batch, pp_proxy_tensors=...)`
  call binds on all of them.
- The pass-through targets were checked against their real signatures:
  `TpModelWorker.forward_batch_generation` and `EAGLEWorkerV2.verify` both
  accept `pp_proxy_tensors`.
- Grep of `test/registered` shows no existing test asserting these
  signatures or instantiating the affected workers in a way the new trailing
  optional parameter would break (`test_weight_update_runners.py` builds the
  workers via `object.__new__`, which bypasses the ABC check anyway).

A maintainer-run CI pass (especially any spec-v2 / PP-adjacent coverage)
would be appreciated to confirm runtime behavior.

@@ -14,7 +14,9 @@
 from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_disagg, get_exec, get_memory, get_schedule
 
 if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import ScheduleBatch
     from sglang.srt.managers.tp_worker import TpModelWorker
+    from sglang.srt.managers.utils import GenerationBatchResult
     from sglang.srt.model_executor.model_runner import (
         ModelRunner,
         SamplingPrewarmResult,
@@ -154,6 +156,23 @@ def __init__(self) -> None:
         self._additional_graph_memory_usage: dict[str, float] = {}
         self._additional_graph_time_usage: dict[str, float] = {}
 
+    @abstractmethod
+    def forward_batch_generation(
+        self,
+        batch: ScheduleBatch,
+        on_publish=None,
+        grammar_barrier=None,
+        pp_proxy_tensors=None,
+    ) -> GenerationBatchResult:
+        """Run one generation step for a schedule batch.
+
+        Every spec-v2 worker must accept the same keyword arguments the
+        scheduler dispatches through (in particular ``pp_proxy_tensors``).
+        Declaring the interface here turns a future signature divergence
+        into a loud failure instead of a first-request ``TypeError``.
+        """
+        ...
+
     @property
     def hicache_draft_plan(self) -> HiCacheDraftPlan:
         return self._hicache_draft_plan

@@ -748,15 +748,21 @@ def spec_v2_attn_backends(self) -> tuple:
         )
 
     def forward_batch_generation(
-        self, batch: ScheduleBatch, on_publish=None, grammar_barrier=None
+        self,
+        batch: ScheduleBatch,
+        on_publish=None,
+        grammar_barrier=None,
+        pp_proxy_tensors=None,
     ):
         # Mirrors EAGLEWorkerV2.forward_batch_generation; the only frozen-specific
         # change is the idle draft-input (FrozenKVMTPDraftInput + recurrent hidden
         # size). The draft / seed-based draft-extend hooks are FrozenKVMTPDraftWorker's.
         if batch.forward_mode.is_extend() or batch.is_extend_in_batch:
             # Target prefill (frozen is never standalone -> capture FULL hidden).
             batch_output = self.target_worker.forward_batch_generation(
-                batch, capture_hidden_mode=CaptureHiddenMode.FULL
+                batch,
+                capture_hidden_mode=CaptureHiddenMode.FULL,
+                pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors,
             )
 
             # Spec_v2 convention: batch.seq_lens = length BEFORE this iter's tokens.
@@ -795,7 +801,11 @@ def forward_batch_generation(
                 verify_input = self.draft_worker.draft(batch)
             assert verify_input.is_verify_input()
             batch.spec_info = verify_input
-            batch_output = self.verify(batch, grammar_barrier=grammar_barrier)
+            batch_output = self.verify(
+                batch,
+                pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors,
+                grammar_barrier=grammar_barrier,
+            )
             # Publish before draft-extend so the fence is at verify-end.
             if on_publish is not None:
                 on_publish(batch_output.new_seq_lens)

@@ -320,10 +320,12 @@ def _run_target_block(
         forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
         *,
         need_top1: bool = True,
+        pp_proxy_tensors=None,
     ) -> tuple:
         result = self.target_worker.forward_batch_generation(
             batch=None,
             forward_batch=forward_batch,
+            pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors,
             is_verify=True,
         )
 
@@ -413,8 +415,11 @@ def _forward_prefill(
         self,
         batch: ScheduleBatch,
         on_publish,
+        pp_proxy_tensors=None,
     ) -> GenerationBatchResult:
-        result = self.target_worker.forward_batch_generation(batch)
+        result = self.target_worker.forward_batch_generation(
+            batch, pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors
+        )
         if not isinstance(result.next_token_ids, torch.Tensor):
             raise RuntimeError("UNO target prefill returned no sampled seed tensor.")
 
@@ -440,6 +445,7 @@ def _forward_decode_tree(
         self,
         batch: ScheduleBatch,
         on_publish,
+        pp_proxy_tensors=None,
     ) -> GenerationBatchResult:
         """Run UNO's F-wide proposal pass, then native EAGLE Q-node verify."""
 
@@ -503,6 +509,7 @@ def _forward_decode_tree(
         draft_result, _ = self._run_draft_block(
             draft_forward_batch,
             need_top1=False,
+            pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors,
         )
         draft_logits = draft_result.logits_output.next_token_logits.reshape(
             batch_size,
@@ -621,9 +628,12 @@ def _forward_decode(
         self,
         batch: ScheduleBatch,
         on_publish,
+        pp_proxy_tensors=None,
     ) -> GenerationBatchResult:
         if self.tree_mode:
-            return self._forward_decode_tree(batch, on_publish)
+            return self._forward_decode_tree(
+                batch, on_publish, pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors
+            )
 
         draft_state = batch.spec_info
 
@@ -695,6 +705,7 @@ def _forward_decode(
         draft_result, candidates = self._run_draft_block(
             draft_forward_batch,
             need_top1=all_greedy,
+            pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors,
         )
         if not all_greedy:
             draft_logits = draft_result.logits_output.next_token_logits.reshape(
@@ -723,6 +734,7 @@ def _forward_decode(
         verify_result, target_top1 = self._run_target_block(
             verify_forward_batch,
             need_top1=all_greedy,
+            pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors,
         )
 
         if all_greedy:
@@ -774,15 +786,20 @@ def forward_batch_generation(
         batch: ScheduleBatch,
         on_publish=None,
         grammar_barrier=None,
+        pp_proxy_tensors=None,
     ) -> GenerationBatchResult:
         del grammar_barrier
         self._validate_batch(batch)
 
         if batch.forward_mode == ForwardMode.EXTEND:
-            return self._forward_prefill(batch, on_publish)
+            return self._forward_prefill(
+                batch, on_publish, pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors
+            )
 
         if batch.forward_mode == ForwardMode.DECODE:
-            return self._forward_decode(batch, on_publish)
+            return self._forward_decode(
+                batch, on_publish, pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors
+            )
 
         raise RuntimeError(
             f"UNO expected an EXTEND or DECODE batch, got {batch.forward_mode}."
@@ -805,6 +822,7 @@ def _run_draft_block(
         forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
         *,
         need_top1: bool = True,
+        pp_proxy_tensors=None,
     ):
         batch_size = forward_batch.batch_size
         self.lora_manager.reset_lora_batch()
@@ -826,6 +844,7 @@ def _run_draft_block(
                 return self._run_target_block(
                     forward_batch,
                     need_top1=need_top1,
+                    pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors,
                 )
 
             graph_runner = getattr(
@@ -848,6 +867,7 @@ def _run_draft_block(
             result = self._run_target_block(
                 forward_batch,
                 need_top1=need_top1,
+                pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors,
             )
             # Clear LoRA routing before verification
             self.lora_manager.reset_lora_batch()
